purpose: Pressure-test runtime-discovered iteration where each item independently selects and executes one of two verified capabilities.
goal: Using a real rendered browser, open https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users, save a screenshot to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_USERS.png, and save the rendered result to canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_USERS.json. Read the live JSON array from that result. For every user returned at runtime, if that user's username length is at most 8 characters generate a QR code image encoding that username; otherwise generate a Code 128 barcode image encoding that username. Save each selected image under canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_CODES using the user's id as the filename, and create canonical/astra_runtime/tmp/FANOUT_MANIFEST.json with exactly one record per live user containing id, username, selected capability kind, and artifact path. Finally independently decode every generated image and verify each decoded value equals that live user's username, every live user has exactly one artifact, and no extra manifest records exist.
